text.tspan: Countries adopting the International Classification of Diseases
The number of countries that have reported to the WHO Mortality Database using a given version of the International
Classification of Diseases (ICD) to classify causes of death.
Note: Countries are only included in the WHO Mortality Database if over 65% of deaths have a registered cause. There is at least an 18-month
lag before countries report finalized data; it should not be inferred from this chart that reporting for the most recent years has decreased.
